title: Safe disk cleaner
goal: Make selection and deletion consequences inspectable, with duplicate detection remaining report-only.
dependencies: Phase 3 has gate.status = passed and all required evidence recorded
preserve: Existing dev artifact recognition rules and configured roots
Revalidation, protected-root handling, Recycle Bin support, deletion journal and interruption reporting
Separate duplicate detection with no filesystem mutation
Existing artifact file-age filter and partial scan limits
implementation: Show explicit root selection for fresh setup and display saved roots before scanning. Show scope and any truncated or interrupted results.
Show a review table with full path, artifact type, size and selection summary. Clear selection on each new scan.
Make Recycle Bin the primary deletion mode and require a review confirmation with count and size. Make permanent removal a secondary action with its own explicit confirmation.

Bind the review to the exact selected artifact IDs, delete mode, and reviewed scan. Selection changes (including same-count swaps), a new or invalidated manifest, or navigation out of review invalidate approval.
Disable action for zero selection, stale manifest or interrupted operation until safe revalidation. Report successes and failures distinctly.
Separate duplicate reports into a read-only view. They must not populate artifact selection or enable any deletion.

automated.expected: Zero selection at scan completion. Wrong or cancelled confirmation preserves all files. Correct confirmation affects only selected eligible artifacts. Same-count A-to-B swaps, mode changes, cancellation, and new/stale manifests cannot submit under an earlier confirmation.
automated.evidence: Passed 29 dashboard API tests and the real WebView2 dashboard_cleaner suite. Exact one-time scan/IDs/mode/size confirmation rejects stale, swapped and overlapping selections; the approved fixture path alone is sent to the recording deleter. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45878372008/job/140111140739

automated.expected: Changed or protected items fail revalidation. Recycle/permanent modes and journal behavior preserve correct per-item results. Permission error does not imply successful removal.
automated.evidence: Passed 68 cleaner tests: scoped and protected paths, reparse/age strictness, journal fail-closed and Recycle warning-mode flags. Real permanent deletion test removed only the approved artifact in a TempDir; legacy Recycle API is not shown as guaranteed recovery. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45878372008/job/140111140739

automated.run: Run the existing duplicate engine suite and dashboard duplicate report test with fixture paths and pre/post checksums.
automated.expected: Duplicates are reported. No destructive control appears for them and all scanned duplicate files stay unchanged.
automated.evidence: Engine and dashboard duplicate suite passed; native run also found one matching in-scope group and SHA-256 checks proved all files, both duplicates and outside canaries were unchanged. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45878372008/job/140111140739 https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45878372008/job/140111140388

real_ui.expected: Roots, count, size and mode are visible. No item starts selected and cancel returns to an intact review.
real_ui.evidence: Actual Windows Server 2025 WebView and mouse: five fixture artifacts, saved root shown, zero selected, explicit Recycle review with count/size, focus on Cancel, cancellation preserved selection and produced no deletion. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45878372008/job/140111140388

real_ui.steps: Open the permanent confirmation without confirming through live UI. Then switch to duplicates and inspect the results.
real_ui.expected: Permanent confirms separately with explicit wording. Duplicate results offer no deletion. Actual deletion verification runs only in isolated automated fixtures.
real_ui.evidence: Actual native mouse: separate permanent confirmation opened and canceled, distinct duplicate view had no destructive controls, one real duplicate group matched; SHA-256 preserved all fixture files. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45878372008/job/140111140388

test_notes: Do not test deletion against user folders. The live independent check can open and cancel confirmations, while the automated suite verifies deletion in temporary fixture data.

Native acceptance opens and cancels confirmation on isolated synthetic data. Actual deletion tests use only temporary fixtures; verify duplicate file pre/post checksums and report any skipped or unavailable test.

findings.title: A confirmation can silently apply to a different artifact
findings.evidence: Mocked the existing handler using two synthetic IDs; in both modes a same-count swap between the first and second click submitted the replacement. No actual deletion was performed.
findings.required_fix: Review exact IDs and scan; invalidate the old confirmation and add regressions for both modes.
findings.resolution: The UI and backend bind approval to exact scan/data/mode and reject stale, swapped, unknown and overlapping selections before cleaning.

findings.title: Fail closed on unsafe or unverified scope
findings.resolution: Remove silent fresh-scan default; preserve explicit roots, reject protected ancestors and reparse ancestry, verify age using strict enumeration and revalidate afterward; write journal before deleting. Recycle does not silently auto-confirm OS permanent fallback.

required: all required acceptance cases passed with evidence
independent orchestrator verification and real UI evidence
affected tests re-passed after any fix
gate.rule: Only the orchestrator can mark passed. Start the next phase only after this gate passes. The fix/retest milestone is inapplicable only when no post-review fix was needed and this is recorded.
